core_obligations: Uniqueness: two lifts S -> X agreeing on Y_0 differ by a map into the diagonal Delta_{X/S}, which is an open immersion since X is etale; the factorization through the closed subscheme forces equality.

Existence: reduce to Y affine; the ideal of S_0 in S is nilpotent (same topological space, e.g. square zero); lift the map step by step using the Algebra smooth-strong-lift lemma applied to the etale (hence smooth) morphism X -> S.
proof_roadmap: uniqueness: diagonal open immersion + factorization; existence: affine reduction + nilpotent thickening + Algebra smooth-strong-lift; both derived in full.
difficulty_reason: Full: uniqueness via diagonal open immersion and factorization; existence via affine reduction, nilpotent ideal, and the Algebra smooth-strong-lift lemma.
